topic: Metabolism as Chemical Reactions in the Body
key_concepts: Metabolism is the set of chemical processes in living cells that maintain life.
Metabolic reactions include anabolic and catabolic pathways.
Anabolic reactions build larger molecules while catabolic reactions break down molecules.
Carbohydrates, proteins, and fats serve as reactants in metabolic reactions.
Metabolic products include ATP, water, and other compounds needed by the body.
Metabolism supports energy balance, growth, repair, and waste elimination.
Food is converted into energy and materials needed for life.
The digestive system changes food and supplies nutrients for cellular metabolism.
Safe nutrition and chemical use practices relate to metabolic health.
Philippine agencies such as DOH and DOST support metabolic health initiatives.
